questions.question: What was Guru Angad Dev Ji's name before he became Guru?
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji was born Lehna (Lahina); Guru Nanak Dev Ji renamed him Angad on choosing him as successor.
questions.source: Britannica – Guru Angad

questions.question: In which village was Guru Angad Dev Ji born?
options: Matte di Sarai (now Sarai Naga, near Muktsar)
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji was born in 1504 at Matte di Sarai, now called Sarai Naga, near Muktsar in Punjab.
questions.source: Britannica – Guru Angad

questions.question: Before meeting Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Bhai Lehna was a devotee of which deity, leading pilgrims to her shrine?
questions.explanation: Bhai Lehna was a devotee of the goddess Durga and used to lead pilgrims to her shrine at Jwalamukhi before he became a Sikh.
questions.source: Sikhs.org – Guru Angad

questions.question: Bhai Lehna was inspired to seek Guru Nanak Dev Ji after hearing which Sikh of Khadur recite Guru Nanak's bani?
questions.explanation: Bhai Jodha, a Sikh living in Khadur, recited Guru Nanak's bani; hearing it, Bhai Lehna set out to meet Guru Nanak Dev Ji at Kartarpur.
questions.source: Sikhs.org – Guru Angad
questions.note: The Sikh Encyclopedia notes two versions of the conversion; the Bhai Jodha account is the common one.

questions.question: What does the name 'Angad', given by Guru Nanak Dev Ji to Bhai Lehna, signify?
options: A part of his own body (ang, limb)
questions.explanation: Guru Nanak Dev Ji named him Angad to signify that the disciple had become as much a part of him as his own limbs (ang).
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia – Angad Dev, Guru

questions.question: Which town became the centre of the Sikh faith during Guru Angad Dev Ji's Guruship?
questions.explanation: After succeeding Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Guru Angad Dev Ji moved to Khadur, which became the centre of the Sikh faith as Kartarpur had been.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia – Angad Dev, Guru

questions.question: Guru Angad Dev Ji is credited with standardising and popularising which script?
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji standardised and popularised the Gurmukhi script, teaching its letters to children; much of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji is written in it.
questions.source: Britannica – Guru Angad

questions.question: Mata Khivi Ji, remembered for her loving service in the langar, was the wife of which Guru?
questions.explanation: Mata Khivi, wife of Guru Angad Dev Ji, supervised the langar at Khadur, which came to be called 'Mata Khivi Ji ka Langar'.
questions.source: Encyclopaedia of Sikhism (Punjabi University) – Khivi, Mata

questions.question: The bards Balvand and Satta praise Mata Khivi in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji for distributing which food in the langar?
options: Kheer (rice cooked in milk, enriched with ghee)
questions.explanation: Balvand's verse (Ang 967) describes Mata Khivi comforting all and distributing kheer rich with ghee — a rare mention of a woman by name in Gurbani.
questions.source: Encyclopaedia of Sikhism (Punjabi University) – Khivi, Mata

questions.question: What activity is the Mal Akhara at Khadur Sahib associated with?
options: Wrestling and physical training of youth
questions.explanation: Gurdwara Mal Akhara marks the spot where Guru Angad Dev Ji had youth take part in wrestling, reflecting his emphasis on physical as well as spiritual health.
questions.source: Encyclopaedia of Sikhism (Punjabi University) – Khadur Sahib

questions.question: According to Sikh tradition, which Mughal emperor came to Khadur to seek Guru Angad Dev Ji's blessing?
questions.explanation: Sikh tradition records that Humayun, retreating after losing his throne, came to Khadur and sought Guru Angad Dev Ji's blessing.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia – Angad Dev, Guru

questions.question: Emperor Humayun visited Khadur after being defeated by whom?
questions.explanation: Humayun, defeated by Sher Shah Suri, was retreating when he came to Khadur; Guru Angad Dev Ji rebuked him when he reached for his sword in anger.
questions.source: Sikhs.org – Guru Angad

questions.question: What were the names of Guru Angad Dev Ji's two sons?
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji and Mata Khivi had two sons, Dasu and Datu, and a daughter, Bibi Amro.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia – Angad Dev, Guru
questions.note: Some writers list a second daughter, Anokhi; only the sons are asked.

questions.question: In what form is Guru Angad Dev Ji's bani recorded in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji?
options: A long chhant in Raag Suhi
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji's bani consists of saloks (63 by the Sikh Encyclopedia's count) found within the vars of Guru Nanak Dev Ji and Guru Amar Das Ji.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia – Angad Dev, Guru
questions.note: Count given as 63 (some count 62); count not asked.

questions.question: After Guru Nanak Dev Ji's passing, Guru Angad Dev Ji secluded himself at Khadur. Who persuaded him to come out and lead the Sikhs?
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji stayed in seclusion until Baba Buddha Ji found him and brought the Sikhs to him; Gurdwara Mai Bharai at Khadur marks the place.
questions.source: Sikhs.org – Guru Angad

questions.question: How did Guru Angad Dev Ji's family earn their simple living at Khadur?
options: Twisting munj reed fibre into string
Working as scribes for the court
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji lived on honest labour; the family ate simple meals earned by twisting munj reed fibre into string.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia – Angad Dev, Guru

questions.question: Who succeeded Guru Angad Dev Ji as the third Sikh Guru?
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji chose his devoted disciple Amar Das as successor, placing a coconut and five coins before him; Baba Buddha Ji applied the tilak.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia – Amar Das, Guru

questions.question: During which period did Guru Angad Dev Ji serve as Guru?
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji was Guru from 1539, when Guru Nanak Dev Ji installed him, until his passing at Khadur in 1552.
questions.source: Britannica – Guru Angad

questions.question: According to tradition, Guru Angad Dev Ji invited which companion of Guru Nanak Dev Ji to Khadur to narrate the Guru's life story?
questions.explanation: Tradition holds that Bhai Bala's recollections were written down in Gurmukhi in Guru Angad Dev Ji's presence, forming the Bhai Bale Vali Janam Sakhi.
questions.source: Encyclopaedia of Sikhism (Punjabi University) – Bala, Bhai
questions.note: Modern scholars question Bhai Bala's historicity and this Janam Sakhi's authenticity; question explicitly framed as tradition.

questions.question: Guru Angad Dev Ji was which Guru in the line of Sikh Gurus?
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji was the second Sikh Guru, succeeding Guru Nanak Dev Ji.
questions.source: Britannica – Guru Angad
